site_acres.label: Site, acres
site_acres.assumption: Industrial lots in the park are listed from 2.02 to 17.95 acres [^5]; six acres leaves room for livestock pens, truck circulation, wastewater pretreatment and a later expansion.

bldg_sf.label: Plant, sq ft (harvest floor, coolers, fabrication, further processing, inspector office)
bldg_sf.assumption: Between the small plants in state guidance and the 29,971 sq ft plant registered in Conroe in 2023 [^31]; sized for about 30 head a day of beef plus a sausage and smoked-meat room.

bldg_psf.label: Building cost per sq ft, 2023 to 2024 Texas meat plant registration

escalation.label: Escalation from the 2023 estimate to a 2027 build
escalation.assumption: The research has no construction cost index for the site. Construction input costs rose 8.9% in the year to August 2026 alone [^68]; 10% is an allowance pending a contractor's bid.

equipment.label: Process equipment (knock box, rail, carcass coolers, fabrication, grinders, smokehouses, packaging)
equipment.assumption: The research has no itemized equipment cost; Maine's guidance, on 2016 data, put equipment at about $50 per sq ft on top of about $350 per sq ft of building [^56]. Coolers and smokehouses push a beef and sausage plant above that ratio. Vendor quotes and the B&I technical report replace this figure.

wastewater.label: Wastewater pretreatment
wastewater.assumption: Wastewater capacity for slaughter at the park is NOT FOUND, and meat plant effluent is strong enough to need pretreatment before a city sewer; a placeholder until the city's industrial pretreatment requirements and an engineer's design are in.

sitework.label: Site work, pens, truck court, paving and utility extensions
sitework.assumption: No site-work cost is in the research; a placeholder for a six-acre industrial pad with livestock receiving.

soft_pct.label: Design, engineering, permits and inspection set-up, share of building and equipment
soft_pct.assumption: No soft-cost share for meat plants is in the research.

contingency_pct.label: Contingency, share of building, equipment, wastewater and site work
contingency_pct.assumption: Higher than a standard building contingency because process equipment and wastewater design are not yet specified.

draw_factor.label: Average share of construction cost outstanding during the build
draw_factor.assumption: Draws rise from zero to the full budget, so about half is outstanding on average.

working_cap.label: Pre-opening costs and start-up working capital
working_cap.assumption: Hiring, training, the FSIS grant-of-inspection process and receivables before steady volume; no figure in the research.

head_day.label: Beef harvest capacity, head per day
head_day.assumption: A small plant under FSIS's HACCP size classes (10 to 499 employees) [^61]; no capacity benchmark for a small Texas plant is in the research.

days.label: Harvest days per year
days.assumption: Five days a week less holidays and maintenance shutdowns; operating days are NOT FOUND in the research.

util.label: Harvest utilization
util.assumption: No ramp benchmark for a small plant is in the research; the only ramp figure is a large Missouri plant that started at 800 head a day toward a 2,400 head-a-day capacity [^55]. Utilization stays below 80% to leave room for seasonal swings.

fee_head.label: Harvest, fabrication and packaging fee per head, Year 1
fee_head.assumption: No competitor posts a processing price sheet, and the research has no kill or cut-and-wrap fee [^16]. The fee is an assumption to be replaced by a phone survey and signed customer commitments.

fee_growth.label: Annual fee increase
fee_growth.assumption: Modest increases; no fee history is in the research.

fp_lbs.label: Further-processed product (sausage, smoked meats), pounds a year
fp_lbs.assumption: Co-packing for the Elgin sausage trade and direct-market producers; Meyer's and Southside both sell wholesale [^18,21]. No volume benchmark is in the research.

fp_fee.label: Further-processing fee per pound
fp_fee.assumption: Co-packing is priced per pound or per batch, but no rate is in the research; to be replaced by quotes.

supplies_pct.label: Packaging, casings, spices and supplies, share of revenue
supplies_pct.assumption: No cost-of-goods share for small plants is in the research.

offal_head.label: Offal, hide and inedible disposal per head
offal_head.assumption: Rendering and offal disposal costs are NOT FOUND in the research; a placeholder per head.

employees.label: Employees (harvest, fabrication, processing, sanitation, office)
employees.assumption: Staffing grows with utilization; a small plant under FSIS's HACCP classes has 10 to 499 employees [^61].

payroll_3116.label: Animal slaughtering and processing payroll, U.S. (NAICS 3116)

emp_3116.label: Animal slaughtering and processing employment, U.S. (NAICS 3116)

wage_growth.label: Annual wage growth
wage_growth.assumption: No Texas or Austin wage series for meat workers is in the research.

benefits.label: Payroll taxes, benefits and workers' compensation load
benefits.assumption: Meat plants carry high workers' compensation costs; no load factor is in the research.

utilities_pct.label: Electricity, gas, water and sewer surcharges, share of revenue
utilities_pct.assumption: Refrigeration, hot water and wastewater surcharges; utility loads are NOT FOUND in the research.

repairs_pct.label: Repairs and maintenance, share of building and equipment cost

insurance.label: Property, liability and product recall insurance, Year 1
insurance.assumption: Wind, flood, fire, product recall and liability insurance are NOT FOUND in the research; a placeholder until a broker quotes.

ga_pct.label: Administration, sales, food safety and quality staff costs not in payroll, share of revenue

bi_guarantee_pct.label: USDA guarantee, loans of $5 million or more (FY2026)

bi_fee_pct.label: Initial guarantee fee, share of the guaranteed amount (FY2026)

bi_retention.label: Annual retention fee on the guaranteed balance (FY2026)

bi_rate.label: Interest rate, fixed
bi_rate.assumption: B&I rates are negotiated between lender and borrower [^49] and the research has no rate. Prime was 7.00% on the H.15 release of October 9, 2026 [^72]; the model uses 7.75% fixed, set at closing

bi_amort_years.label: Amortization
bi_amort_years.assumption: Term follows the useful life of the collateral, up to 40 years [^49]; 25 years blends a building life with process equipment that wears out sooner

bi_equity_min_pct.label: Minimum equity (lender requirement)
bi_equity_min_pct.assumption: No B&I equity rule is in the research. A start-up plant with no operating history is held to 20% by the lender's credit policy in this case; the lender confirms its own requirement and USDA's balance sheet test.

bi_dscr_floor.label: Minimum DSCR (lender requirement)
bi_dscr_floor.assumption: No B&I coverage floor is in the research; 1.25x is the lender's floor in this case, tested in Year 3 when the plant reaches stable utilization.

bi_loan_cap.label: B&I maximum loan (FY2026 fee notice tiers)

reserve.label: Ramp-up operating and debt service reserve
reserve.assumption: The plant loses money in Year 1 and does not cover debt service in Year 2 in this model; a funded reserve carries part of that gap. The sponsor's lender sets the final amount from the monthly ramp.

tax_county.label: Bastrop County tax rate, tax year 2025 ($0.42870 per $100)

tax_city.label: City of Elgin tax rate, tax year 2025 ($0.619300 per $100)

tax_isd.label: Elgin ISD tax rate, tax year 2025 ($1.223400 per $100)

tax_acc.label: Austin Community College tax rate, tax year 2025 ($0.103400 per $100)

growth_insurance.label: Insurance growth per year
growth_insurance.assumption: Insurance grows 3% a year, a labelled allowance; no quoted premium for the subject exists, so a bound quote replaces it before closing.

uses.label: Site work, pens and truck court
Contingency
uses.expr: (bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + equipment + wastewater + sitework) * contingency_pct

uses.label: Construction-period interest
uses.expr: (bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + equipment + wastewater + sitework) * draw_factor * bi_rate * build_months / 12

uses.label: Ramp-up operating and debt service reserve

revenue.label: Beef harvest, fabrication and packaging fees
revenue.expr: head_day * days * util * fee_head * (1 + fee_growth) ** y

cost_of_sales.label: Offal and inedible disposal
cost_of_sales.expr: head_day * days * util * offal_head * (1 + fee_growth) ** y

opex.label: Wages, at the NAICS 3116 average, plus benefits
Property tax
opex.expr: (site_acres * land_per_acre + bldg_sf * bldg_psf * (1 + escalation) + equipment + wastewater + sitework) * (tax_county + tax_city + tax_isd + tax_acc)

opex.label: USDA annual retention fee (on a loan at minimum equity, before amortization)

proposed.note: the sponsor proposes the lender's 20% minimum equity

glance: Elgin, Bastrop County, Texas, on the US 290 and SH 95 corridor at the eastern edge of the Austin metro; industrial park lot just off US 290 [^1,12]
Hypothetical USDA-inspected plant: beef harvest of up to {in_head_day} head a day, fabrication and a sausage and smoked-meat room, {in_bldg_sf} sq ft on {in_site_acres} acres
USDA Business and Industry guaranteed loan, FY2026 terms as last published; FY2027 terms not found [^44,53]
{tpc}, about {tpc_per_unit} per sq ft of plant
Guaranteed loan {loan_total} at {in_bi_rate}, {in_bi_amort_years}, {in_bi_guarantee_pct} USDA guarantee; annual debt service {ds}
{dscr_y3} in Year 3 (proposed loan: {dscr_y3_proposed}); {dscr_y1} in Year 1 and {dscr_y2} in Year 2, carried by the reserve
{breakeven_value} harvest utilization in Year 3, a {cushion_pct} cushion
Sound location, growing county and Texas cattle supply; no competitor publishes fees, so revenue must be contracted, not inferred
Fails: {equity_proposed_pct} equity and a {loan_total_proposed} loan cover Year 3 debt service {dscr_y3_proposed}, below the {floor} floor
Meets: equity raised to {equity_pct}, loan cut to {loan_total}, Year 3 coverage {dscr_y3}; slaughter zoning, wastewater, FY2027 terms and throughput commitments are conditions
